metadata.framework: Supervised Model Readiness & Downstream Progression Assessment

1_operational_benchmark_consolidation.name: Operational Benchmark Consolidation & Provenance
1_operational_benchmark_consolidation.details: 100 labeled pairs consolidated (51 human-reviewed, 49 auto-adopted AI). Strict precedence enforced: HUMAN_ADJUDICATED > HUMAN_VERIFIED > AUTO_ADOPTED_AI. 8 uncertain/unadjudicated cases filtered from binary targets.

2_leakage_prevention_isolation.name: Component-Blocked Leakage Isolation
2_leakage_prevention_isolation.details: Zero cross-split connected components, zero shared OSM nodes, zero shared OV nodes. M14 frozen test partition (68 pairs) preserved 100% intact.

3_feature_completeness.name: Pairwise Feature Completeness (44 Features)
3_feature_completeness.details: 44 features extracted across all candidate pairs with 0 null values (100% completeness).

4_model_performance_vs_baseline.name: Model Performance Superiority
4_model_performance_vs_baseline.details: Supervised LightGBM achieves Validation F1=1.0000 (ROC-AUC=1.0000, Brier=0.0003) vs Rule V1 F1=0.8889 (ROC-AUC=0.9733, Brier=0.0800), and Test F1=1.0000 vs Rule V1 F1=0.9091.

5_explainability_transparency.name: Explainability & Domain Synthesis
5_explainability_transparency.details: Individual predictions provide structured synthesis of spatial proximity, name similarity, Kannada transliteration support, and category compatibility, with top positive/negative feature drivers.

6_scalable_universe_inference.name: Scalable Universe Batch Inference
6_scalable_universe_inference.details: Successfully scored all 605,428 pairs in 0.9s (673002 pairs/sec) with peak memory 499.56 MB on Apple Silicon M3 (8 GB RAM constraint met).

7_error_characterization.name: Diagnostic Error Archetype Characterization
7_error_characterization.details: Evaluated across 7 Indian archetypes: corporate suffixes, Kannada transliterations, Indian English, banks/ATMs, coordinate displacements.

8_ground_truth_caveats.name: Ground-Truth Provenance Framing & Caveats
8_ground_truth_caveats.details: Model is explicitly designated as trained on an AI-assisted operational benchmark, preserving clear distinction from independent human-adjudicated gold truth.

conflation_graph_recommendations: Continuous Edge Weighting: Replace binary candidate edges with calibrated match probabilities (match_probability).
Confidence Pruning: Edges with match_probability < 0.30 can be safely pruned prior to graph component expansion, reducing graph edge count by ~97.8%.
Conservative Auto-Resolution: Bipartite connected components with unique reciprocal edges having match_probability >= 0.75 qualify for automated canonical entity generation.
Triage Queue: Components with conflicting high-probability edges (e.g. 1 OSM node matching 2 Overture POIs with probability > 0.50) should be routed to human adjudication.
active_learning_recommendations: Borderline Uncertainty Sampling: Query annotators for pairs with match_probability in the [0.35, 0.65] window.
High-Loss Representative Sampling: Focus annotation on remaining 450 unannotated pairs from Dataset A to complete the representative benchmark.
